name: Disable Delivery Optimization
description: Turns off peer-to-peer sharing for Delivery Optimization. Windows can still download updates over HTTP.

description_i18n.en: Turns off peer-to-peer sharing for Delivery Optimization. Windows can still download updates over HTTP.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Peer-to-Peer-Freigabe der Übermittlungsoptimierung. Windows kann Updates weiterhin über HTTP herunterladen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le partage pair à pair de l’Optimisation de la distribution. Windows peut toujours télécharger les mises à jour via HTTP.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: This policy is shared with the peer-to-peer tweaks. Removing it clears the app-configured mode without recovering a previous custom mode.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Sets DODownloadMode to 0 (HTTP without peering) in HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization.
